_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #5／6：否定副詞句首倒裝（eng.t_sub.special.inversion-negative，manifest tier＝t_adv，學測級）。否定/限定副詞置句首強調時，主詞與助動詞倒裝（像問句）：Never have I seen...；Seldom does he complain（無助動詞用 do/does/did）；Not only did she sing, but she also danced；No sooner had I sat down than...。誘答鎖『句首倒裝卻不倒裝／用 do 卻保留原本動詞字尾/時態／No sooner 用 did 而非 had』等結構性錯誤。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ivn_）。

units.title_zh: 否定副詞句首倒裝（Never／Seldom／Hardly／Not only…）
units.can_do: 我能在否定或限定副詞置於句首時，把主詞與助動詞倒裝（像問句一樣），包含無助動詞時補 do/does/did，以及 No sooner … than 的用法。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型：否定副詞句首倒裝
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When a negative adverb such as 'never', 'seldom', 'rarely' or 'hardly' begins a sentence for emphasis, the subject and auxiliary are inverted, as in a question: 'Never have I been so embarrassed.'
claims.verification_ref: 否定副詞（never/seldom/rarely/hardly）置句首強調→主詞與助動詞倒裝（Never have I been...）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 代入朗讀複核

claims.text: If there is no other auxiliary verb, the inversion uses 'do', 'does' or 'did', and the main verb goes back to its base form: 'Seldom does he make a mistake' (not 'Seldom he makes').
claims.verification_ref: 無助動詞時用 do/does/did 倒裝、主動詞回原形（Seldom does he make...）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Not only' at the front of a clause also causes inversion: 'Not only did he apologize, but he also paid for the damage.'
claims.verification_ref: Not only 置句首也要倒裝（Not only did he apologize, but he also...）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'No sooner ... than' describes one event happening immediately after another, with inversion and the past perfect in the 'no sooner' clause: 'No sooner had we left than it began to rain.'
claims.verification_ref: No sooner ... than 表一事剛發生另一事就…，倒裝＋過去完成（No sooner had we left than...）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When a negative adverb like 'never' or 'seldom' comes first for emphasis, invert the subject and auxiliary, just like a question. 否定副詞（never、seldom…）置句首強調時，主詞和助動詞要倒裝，像問句一樣。
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
teach.zh_hint: 我從沒看過這麼美的日落。Never 句首→have I 倒裝。

teach.body: If there is no auxiliary, use 'do/does/did' and put the main verb back to its base form. 若句中沒有助動詞，就補 do/does/did，主動詞回原形。

teach.zh_hint: 她很少遲到。無助動詞→does she arrive，arrive 回原形。

teach.body: 'Not only ...' and 'No sooner ... than ...' also trigger inversion; 'no sooner' takes the past perfect. Not only、No sooner ... than ... 也要倒裝；no sooner 子句用過去完成。
Not only did he win the race, but he also broke the record.
teach.zh_hint: 他不僅贏了比賽，還打破紀錄。Not only→did he win 倒裝。

practice.stem: 選正確：Never ____ such a delicious meal.（否定副詞句首倒裝）

distractor_rationales.I have eaten: Never 置句首時要倒裝成 have I eaten，不能維持 I have eaten 的原語序。
distractor_rationales.I ate: 否定副詞句首要倒裝；而且此處用現在完成，正確是 have I eaten。
distractor_rationales.did I ate: did 後面要接原形（did I eat）；而且本句用現在完成 have I eaten。

practice.feedback: Never have I eaten...：否定副詞句首→助動詞 have 與主詞 I 倒裝。

practice.stem: 選正確：Seldom ____ about his own problems.（句中無助動詞→用 does）

distractor_rationales.he talks: Seldom 句首要倒裝，不能維持 he talks 原語序。
distractor_rationales.he does talk: 語序沒有倒裝；倒裝應是 does he talk（助動詞在主詞前）。
distractor_rationales.does he talks: 用了 does 之後主動詞回原形 talk，不加 -s；正確是 does he talk。

practice.feedback: Seldom does he talk...：無助動詞→補 does、主動詞回原形。

practice.stem: 選正確：Not only ____ the exam, but she also got the highest score.（Not only 句首倒裝）

distractor_rationales.she passed: Not only 置句首要倒裝，不能維持 she passed 原語序。
distractor_rationales.she did pass: 語序沒有倒裝；倒裝應是 did she pass（助動詞在主詞前）。
distractor_rationales.did she passed: 用了 did 之後主動詞回原形 pass，不用過去式 passed。

practice.feedback: Not only did she pass...：Not only 句首→did she pass 倒裝。

practice.stem: 選正確：No sooner ____ down than the phone rang.（No sooner ... than，倒裝＋過去完成）

distractor_rationales.I had sat: No sooner 置句首要倒裝成 had I sat，不能維持 I had sat 原語序。
distractor_rationales.I sat: No sooner 子句用過去完成並倒裝（had I sat），不是過去簡單式且無倒裝。
distractor_rationales.did I sit: No sooner 子句用 had + 過去分詞（had I sat），不用 did。

practice.feedback: No sooner had I sat down than...：倒裝＋過去完成（had + 過去分詞）。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（他很少遲到）

Rarely 置句首要倒裝成 is he late，不能維持 he is 原語序。
句中已有 be 動詞 is，直接倒裝 is he late 即可，不需要再補 does。
語序與動詞都錯；本句該用 be 動詞倒裝：Rarely is he late。

practice.feedback: Rarely is he late：否定副詞句首→be 動詞 is 與主詞 he 倒裝。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Never have I seen（倒裝）、such a beautiful sunset、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。句首否定副詞重讀、倒裝助動詞接主詞、句尾下收。

lines.intonation: Seldom 重讀、does she arrive 連讀、late 句尾下收

lines.text: Not only did he win, but he also broke the record.
lines.intonation: Not only 重讀、逗號略停、record 句尾下收
